requirement_text.REQ-420:
CI: add a path-filtered Mobile gate job to .github/workflows/ci.yml -- flutter analyze, flutter test, Android debug build -- for apps/mobile/**

.github/workflows/ci.yml has jobs `changes`, `backend` and `frontend` and no Flutter job (verified 2026-09-27). Without one, every MOB requirement after REQ-419 would merge with its tests unrun by CI. This requirement is sequenced immediately after REQ-419 and before REQ-421 (MOB-2 depends on it) so that CI exists before the second MOB requirement merges.
Owner MOBILE-DEV, by the REQ-138 precedent (FRONTEND-DEV added the frontend job): the job runs flutter, which only MOBILE-DEV's capability row covers. REQ-417 widens MOBILE-DEV's write scope to this job.

Read lib/letflow/design/iss0591-iss0592-ci-dedup-path-filter.md in full first; ci.yml's own header warns not to "simplify" its path-filter choices. Follow the existing pattern exactly:
1. `changes` job: add a `mobile` output. In the push branch (ISS-0840: push to main always runs every gate) and in both fail-safe branches (no usable base SHA, unreachable base SHA) and in the `fallback` step, emit mobile=true. In the diff branch, mobile is true iff a changed path matches ^(apps/mobile/|\.github/workflows/ci\.yml). Do not change the backend/frontend regexes. Do not add mobile to path-filter-outputs.txt (cd.yml does not deploy mobile).
2. A new sibling job `mobile`, name "Mobile gate (flutter analyze + test + build)", runs-on ubuntu-latest, needs: changes, job-level `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}` (NOT always(), NOT a job-level path condition -- same reasoning as backend/frontend), defaults working-directory apps/mobile. Steps: checkout; actions/setup-java (Temurin 17); subosito/flutter-action with flutter-version-file apps/mobile/pubspec.yaml and cache enabled; then, each with step-level `if: needs.changes.outputs.mobile != 'false'` (fail-open): `flutter pub get`, `flutter analyze`, `flutter test`, `flutter build apk --debug`.
3. No other job's keys change.

OPEN QUESTION (flagged, not resolved here): whether "Mobile gate (...)" becomes a third required status-check context on main per docs/migration/decisions/0018-branch-protection-posture.md. Changing branch protection is a 0018 amendment and belongs to REVIEWER/ORCH, not to this requirement. This requirement only makes the job eligible (always-runs, step-gated, so a required context would never be reported missing) and records the question in the job's header comment.

result.summary:
Implemented all three edits from lib/letflow/design/req420-ci-mobile-gate.md verbatim. `changes` job: added `mobile: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.mobile || steps.fallback.outputs.mobile }}` to `outputs:`; added `echo "mobile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"` to the push branch (with the comment text changed from 'both gates' to 'all gates', per design §2b), both fail-safe branches (no usable base SHA; base SHA unreachable after targeted fetch), and the fallback step (also 'both gates' -> 'all gates' wording); added the new diff-branch regex block `^(apps/mobile/|\.github/workflows/ci\.yml)` immediately after the unchanged frontend regex block. Did not touch the backend or frontend regex strings, any existing backend=/frontend= line, or the `path-filter-outputs.txt` step (still writes only backend/frontend, per REQ-420's own instruction that cd.yml does not deploy mobile). Appended the new `jobs.mobile` block as a sibling after `jobs.frontend`, byte-for-byte per the design's §3 verbatim block: name 'Mobile gate (flutter analyze + test + build)', runs-on ubuntu-latest, needs: changes, `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}`, defaults.run.working-directory apps/mobile, steps actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-java@v4 (temurin, 17), subosito/flutter-action@v2 (flutter-version-file: apps/mobile/pubspec.yaml, cache: true), then flutter pub get / flutter analyze / flutter test / flutter build apk --debug, each `if: needs.changes.outputs.mobile != 'false'`. Included the job's header comment recording the 0018 required-status-check question as open, matching the design's exact wording.

Verification (real output):

`python -c "import yaml,sys; d=yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml')); print(sorted(d['jobs'])); print(d['jobs']['mobile']['name']); print(d['jobs']['mobile']['if'])"` ->

`git diff origin/main -- .github/workflows/ci.yml` (full diff reviewed): every hunk inside the `changes` job is a pure added line (new `mobile:` output line, new `echo "mobile=true"` lines in the push branch/both fail-safe branches/fallback step, new mobile regex block after the untouched frontend regex block, two comment-wording edits from 'both gates' to 'all gates' which are the only non-addition text changes and are outside `jobs.backend`/`jobs.frontend`); no line inside `jobs.backend` or `jobs.frontend` appears in the diff at all; the backend regex (`^(lib/|priv/repo/migrations/|test/|mix\.exs|mix\.lock|\.tool-versions|config/|\.github/workflows/ci\.yml)`) and frontend regex (`^(web/|\.github/workflows/ci\.yml)`) are unchanged (not present in the diff). The new `jobs.mobile` block is a pure addition at end of file.

`grep -n "path-filter-outputs.txt" .github/workflows/ci.yml` -> only the three pre-existing lines (backend=/frontend=/cat), confirming mobile was not added there.

`grep -n "if: needs.changes.outputs.mobile" .github/workflows/ci.yml` -> four matches (lines 477, 481, 485, 489), one per flutter step (pub get, analyze, test, build apk --debug).

`git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD` (pre-final-commit) -> docs/requirements.yaml, docs/status/requirement_status.index.yaml, docs/status/requirement_status.v23.yaml, handoffs/WF02-REQ420-20260928/step-01-code-designer.json, handoffs/WF02-REQ420-20260928/step-01b-code-design-validator.json, lib/letflow/design/req420-ci-mobile-gate.md -- these are the prior commits on this branch (design + dispatch steps); this step's own commit adds only .github/workflows/ci.yml and this handoff file, staying within write scope.
